column11: measured against the same WAC. CMS Medicare Part B 2024 (drug_demand) records $1,933,800,338 over 62,964,187 dosage units; HCPCS J9299 is 'injection, nivolumab, 1 mg', so the allowed amount is $30.713 a mg. Medicare Part B pays 106% of the average sales price (Social Security Act section 1847A) and ASP is already net of manufacturer discounts and rebates, so nivolumab's ASP is $30.713 / 1.06 = $28.974 a mg. The WAC above is $3,309.60 / 100 mg = $33.096 a mg. 1 - 28.974 / 33.096 = 12.45% off list
